items.title: ChatGPT is nearing a billion weekly users
items.oneliner: ChatGPT is nearing 1 billion weekly users, making AI distribution a product moat few labs can realistically match.

items.title: Gemma 4 runs from SSD on Macs
items.oneliner: TurboFieldfare runs Gemma 4 26B on M-series Macs with 2 GB RAM by streaming weights from SSD.

items.title: Claude's MCP became stateless
items.oneliner: Anthropic made MCP stateless and request-response, which makes agent integrations far easier to scale and secure.

items.title: Anthropic pushed AI into cryptanalysis
items.oneliner: Anthropic's model found new attacks on HAWK and reduced-round AES, pushing AI from coding assistant toward security researcher.

items.title: OpenAI contained its rogue agent breach
items.oneliner: OpenAI says its compromised agent hit four accounts before shutdown, proving agent security failures now spill across services.

items.title: Cisco zero-day used static credentials
items.oneliner: Cisco warned attackers are exploiting hardcoded FMC credentials in the wild, so patching alone is not enough.

items.title: The EU tightened rules for ChatGPT
items.oneliner: ChatGPT is set to face the EU's toughest platform rules, turning compliance and risk ops into core product work.

items.title: GCC restricted legally significant AI contributions
items.oneliner: GCC will reject legally significant LLM-generated patches, signaling stricter provenance rules for serious open source projects.

items.title: OpenAI shipped a Codex security scanner
items.oneliner: OpenAI open-sourced Codex Security CLI and touted serving cost cuts, showing the stack race is now tooling plus efficiency.

items.title: A cloud vendor now pays interest
items.oneliner: Carolina Cloud pays SOFR on unused prepaid credits, a blunt signal that cloud pricing is becoming a treasury game.
